AM I A CANDIDATE FOR VENEERS?

Veneers may be right for you if you want to:

Conceal chips, cracks, or worn edges
Correct discoloration resistant to whitening
Close small gaps between teeth
Refine the size, shape, or symmetry of your smile

During your consultation, Dr. Oh will evaluate your oral health and cosmetic goals. If veneers aren’t the ideal solution, she may recommend alternatives like bonding or crowns. We also offer a full scope of general dentistry services to improve your oral health if you don't initially qualify. Every recommendation Dr. Oh provides is in your best interest, so you can expect an honest assessment and an effective strategy for realizing the smile you’re dreaming of.

VENEERS AND SMILE MAKEOVERS

For many Angelenos, veneers are just one step in a larger transformation. As part of a comprehensive smile makeover, Dr. Oh often combines veneers with other types of cosmetic dentistry like Invisalign®, teeth whitening, or dental bonding to create a result that feels balanced, radiant, and uniquely yours. Whether you need one veneer or a full transformation, Dr. Oh will design a plan that aligns with your vision and lifestyle.

CALL NOW TO BOOK
HOW DR. OH DETERMINES IF VENEERS ARE RIGHT FOR YOU

Veneers are an amazing option for the right smile, but the best results start with the right foundation. During your consultation with our dentist in Los Angeles, Dr. Oh looks beyond the surface to make sure porcelain veneers will be truly worth your investment. She’ll evaluate:

GUM HEALTH AND INFLAMMATION

Healthy, stable gums are essential. If you have gum disease, swelling, or recession, Dr. Oh may recommend periodontal care first so your veneers sit on a clean, predictable frame.

ORAL HEALTH AND DECAY RISK

Cavities, failing fillings, and enamel weakness can affect how veneers bond and how long they last. Any underlying issues should be addressed before cosmetic work begins.

BITE ALIGNMENT, GRINDING, OR CLENCHING

If your bite places heavy pressure on the front teeth or if you grind at night, Dr. Oh may recommend orthodontics, a night guard, or another solution to protect your results.

REQUEST A CONSULTATION
WHEN A CROWN MAY BE THE BETTER OPTION

Veneers in Los Angeles are ideal for cosmetic enhancement, but a crown can be the smarter choice when a tooth is significantly weakened, heavily filled, cracked, or has extensive damage. In these cases, a crown can provide full-coverage strength while still delivering a beautiful, natural-looking result.

If veneers are not your best match, Dr. Oh will walk you through alternatives like bonding, whitening, Invisalign, or crowns so your plan fits your smile and your long-term oral health.

CARING FOR YOUR VENEERS

Your veneers are designed to look incredible and feel natural, but long-term results depend on a few simple habits. At Avenue Dental in Los Angeles, Dr. Oh will guide you on how to protect your new smile so it stays polished, comfortable, and photo-ready. Instructions include:

Brush twice a day and floss once a day to support healthy gums around your veneers.
Keep up with routine cleanings so we can monitor your bite and protect your enamel.
Avoid biting hard items with your front teeth (ice, hard candy, nails, packaging).
If you grind or clench, ask about a custom night guard to help protect your veneers and natural teeth.
FAQ
ABOUT VENEERS IN LOS ANGELES, CA
How long do porcelain veneers last?

With proper care, veneers placed by Dr. Oh can last 10–15 years or more. She uses premium porcelain and works with elite labs to ensure durability and longevity.

Do veneers look natural?

They do when you choose a great provider. Dr. Oh designs veneers to complement your facial features and skin tone. Her K-beauty aesthetic ensures results that are stunning yet absolutely natural-looking.

Is the procedure painful?

Most patients report little to no discomfort. Dr. Oh uses advanced techniques and gentle anesthesia to make the process as comfortable as possible.

How many veneers will I need?

It depends on your goals. Some patients receive a single veneer to enhance one tooth, while others may choose to receive 6–10 veneers to transform their entire smile. Dr. Oh will recommend the right plan for you.

Will veneers damage my teeth?

When placed by a skilled provider like Dr. Oh, veneers require minimal alteration of the tooth surface. She prioritizes preserving as much of your natural tissue as possible while delivering stunning results.
